greeting: Your calendar is a blank canvas today. Just you, the agents, and a wide-open runway.

push.title: Turn the deploy runbook into a go/no-go call
push.body: The runbook merged yesterday but still waits on four decisions only you can make: the host size, the object-store provider, the missing TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY (OPS-373), and where the deploy tool gets installed. Review also flagged five correctness gaps after the merge. I can pull all of it into one prioritized readiness brief.

todos.title: Finish and merge MR !51, the verify-skill sync
todos.body: Your only open merge request, ready for review since Aug 31. Review left two P1s and a P2 unaddressed: add a recording for the job-detail flow, require seeded data for REST verification, and restore the executable bit on control.mjs.

todos.title: Fix the failing verification dashboard pipeline
todos.body: The scheduled monitoring run hard-failed at 10:13 yesterday on a deprecated artifact action. It will keep failing on main every run until it is bumped.

updates.title: Postgres test-isolation fix merged, with loose ends
updates.label: Platform
updates.body: OPS-369 landed on main: per-process throwaway databases, 2,602 stale checkpoint rows cleaned, suite slightly faster. Review flagged two edge cases that slipped through: orphaned test databases when setup aborts, and a partial-config path that can still write the shared database.
